payload.name: GoProfiles
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GoProfiles helps teams get to know each other, celebrate wins, and stay connected by turning your company directory into a searchable, conversational people platform.

With the GoProfiles app for ChatGPT, employees can search their company's employee directory, pull up rich coworker profiles, and get the context they need to collaborate without leaving ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to find someone by name, role, or team, look up a colleague's background and profile, check who's celebrating a birthday, work anniversary, or new hire milestone this week, see a coworker's availability, schedule a meeting with them, or give a Bravo to recognize great work.

GoProfiles makes it easier for teams to build genuine connections and cultivate a culture of appreciation. Instead of digging through spreadsheets or asking around, employees can simply ask ChatGPT to find the right person, celebrate the right moment, or say thanks in the right way.

Use GoProfiles in ChatGPT to strengthen team culture, reduce time spent searching for people, and give your team a faster way to recognize and connect with each other.
payload.longDescription:

让 ChatGPT 按姓名、职位或团队查找人员，查询同事的背景和资料，查看本周谁过生日、纪念入职周年或迎来新员工里程碑，了解同事是否有空、安排会议，或发送 Bravo 以表彰出色工作。

GoProfiles 让团队更容易建立真诚的联系并营造互相欣赏的文化。员工无需翻找电子表格或四处打听，只需让 ChatGPT 找到合适的人、庆祝恰当的时刻，或用合适的方式表达感谢。

payload.name: Mailbox MCP
payload.summaryOriginal: Read, send and file your email
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mailbox MCP connects ChatGPT to a mailbox you already own, on Microsoft 365, Gmail, or any IMAP host. There is no new address and nothing to migrate.

People often ask how to connect ChatGPT to Outlook. The distinction that matters is this: it does not drive the Outlook application on your computer. It opens the same mailbox Outlook opens, on the server. So it works whether Outlook is running or not, from any device, and it works the same way whether your mail lives on Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Gmail, or a hosting company's IMAP server.

It can triage what has arrived and say what actually needs you, search across folders, read a whole thread in order, read what is inside an attachment (an invoice total, a spreadsheet, a scanned letter), draft a reply for you to check before it goes, send, forward with the original attachments intact, flag, archive, report junk, and file messages into folders. It can look up someone you have written to before, tell you whether a message bounced and whether that bounce was permanent, and check the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for your own domain.

Your address book comes with the mailbox: Outlook contacts on Microsoft 365, or a CardDAV book on any host that offers one. It can find a person, read their card with the postal address and postcode, add and correct contacts, and import a contacts file. Mailboxes on Microsoft 365, and any host offering CalDAV, get calendar tools on the same connection: read and search the diary, create and update events, check who is free, find a meeting time, send and answer invitations, and set an out of office reply. Which tools appear is measured against your servers when you connect, so you are never offered one they could not honour.

Every connection carries a permission level you choose at approval: read only, draft and file, or send and delete. A shared mailbox can be worked by a team: claim a message so colleagues see who has it, hand one to a named person, and hold a draft for the owner's approval before it is sent.

It is built so the mailbox is left exactly as you would have left it yourself. Replies carry the threading headers, so they nest inside the conversation in the recipient's client rather than starting a new one. Reading a message does not mark it as read. Exactly one copy of anything sent is filed in Sent. Moving a message keeps its flags and its original date. Nothing you read is stored: mail, calendar and contact content passes through the server in memory and is never written down.

Destructive actions are labelled as destructive, and it refuses rather than guesses. It will not delete a folder that still holds messages, and it stops to ask before replying to an address that differs from the visible sender. The company behind it, BSolve IT Limited, holds Cyber Essentials certification.
payload.longDescription:
Mailbox MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到你已有的邮箱，可以是 Microsoft 365、Gmail 或任何 IMAP 服务商提供的邮箱。无需新建邮箱地址，也无需迁移任何内容。

人们常问如何将 ChatGPT 连接到 Outlook。关键区别在于：它不会操控电脑上的 Outlook 应用，而是在服务器上打开 Outlook 所访问的同一个邮箱。因此，无论 Outlook 是否运行，都能从任何设备使用；无论邮件存放在 Microsoft 365、Google Workspace、Gmail，还是托管服务商的 IMAP 服务器上，使用方式都一样。

它可以分拣新收到的邮件，指出哪些确实需要你处理；跨文件夹搜索；按顺序阅读完整邮件讨论串；读取附件内容（发票总额、电子表格、扫描信件）；起草回复供你在发送前检查；发送邮件；保留原附件进行转发；标记、归档、举报垃圾邮件，以及将邮件归入文件夹。它还可以查找你曾写信联系过的人，告知邮件是否被退回以及是否属于永久退信，并检查你自己域名的 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 和 MX 记录。

通讯录随邮箱一同接入：Microsoft 365 上的 Outlook 联系人，或任何支持 CardDAV 的服务商所提供的通讯录。它可以查找人员，读取包含邮寄地址和邮政编码的联系人名片，添加及修正联系人，并导入联系人文件。Microsoft 365 邮箱，以及任何支持 CalDAV 的服务商，都可以通过同一连接使用日历工具：读取和搜索日程，创建及更新日程事项，查看谁有空，寻找会议时间，发送及回复邀请，并设置外出自动回复。连接时会根据你的服务器检查可用工具，因此不会向你提供服务器无法执行的工具。

每个连接都采用你在授权时选择的权限级别：只读、起草及归档，或发送及删除。团队可以共同处理共享邮箱：认领邮件，让同事知道由谁处理；将邮件交给指定人员；或保留草稿，待所有者批准后再发送。

它的设计目标是让邮箱保持在与你亲自操作时完全相同的状态。回复会保留邮件线程头信息，因此会在收件人的邮件客户端中归入原对话，而不会新建对话。阅读邮件不会将其标记为已读。每封发送的邮件在“已发送”中只保存一份。移动邮件会保留其标记和原始日期。读取的内容不会被存储：邮件、日历和联系人内容只在服务器内存中流转，绝不会写入存储。

破坏性操作会明确标注；遇到不确定情况，它会拒绝操作，不会猜测。它不会删除仍包含邮件的文件夹；若回复地址与可见发件人不同，也会先停下来询问。其背后的公司 BSolve IT Limited 已获得 Cyber Essentials 认证。

payload.name: Never Boring AI
payload.description: 在 LinkedIn 帖子中查找陈词滥调
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Paste a LinkedIn post and see which rhetorical formulas readers have seen too often.

The plugin counts a small set of formulas and compares each count with a reference corpus of published LinkedIn posts in the same language. For every formula, it reports the value found, how the post compares with the reference posts and, when a formula is used more than usual, a concrete suggestion to say the same thing more directly.

French and English, and it says which one it measured. French carries three formulas: the "ce n'est pas X, c'est Y" contrast, three lines in a row opening on the same word, and the announced lesson ("Résultat :"). English carries one, the "it's not X, it's Y" contrast: the other two were measured on English posts and were not reliable, so they are left out.

It is a style check only. It does not rewrite the post, and it does not assess who wrote it or how it was produced. No account needed.
payload.longDescription:
粘贴一篇 LinkedIn 帖子，查看读者已经看腻了哪些修辞套路。

该插件会统计一小组修辞套路，并将每项统计结果与同一语言的 LinkedIn 已发布帖子参考语料进行比较。它会报告每种套路的出现次数、该帖与参考帖子的对比情况；如果某种套路的使用频率高于常见水平，还会给出具体建议，帮助你更直接地表达相同意思。

支持法语和英语，并会说明实际检测的语言。法语检测三种套路：“这不是 X，而是 Y”的对比句式、连续三行以相同词语开头，以及预告式结论（“Résultat :”）。英语检测一种套路：“it’s not X, it’s Y”的对比句式；另外两种也曾在英语帖子中检测，但结果不可靠，因此不纳入。

这只是风格检查。它不会改写帖子，也不会评估作者身份或帖子是如何生成的。无需账户。

The games themselves are played by people in the browser: starting one still requires a human to press Start, and the app cannot answer, vote, guess, or draw on anyone's behalf.
payload.longDescription: Fun Friday 为远程团队提供 20 多种线上团队建设游戏，包括问答、绘画、虚张声势、打字竞赛等。连接后，ChatGPT 可以告诉你团队能玩哪些游戏、创建房间并提供可分享的房间代码和加入链接、查看所有人是否已加入以及当前赢家，并在结束后汇报排名。游戏由玩家在浏览器中亲自进行：开始游戏仍需由真人点击 Start，应用不能代替任何人答题、投票、猜测或绘画。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your TimelinesAI WhatsApp inbox to ChatGPT. List chats, read history, send messages, react, label, assign teammates — all as you, in production.

Connect it to ChatGPT to search and read your SMS and email conversations, triage threads, reply by text or email, and keep contacts tidy, all from the lines you choose when you sign in. Access follows your role in your workspace, and you can disconnect at any time.
payload.longDescription: CommSync将团队的业务短信和邮件整合到一个共享收件箱：支持所有电话线路（Twilio、JustCall、Quo、RingCentral、Telnyx等）和所有邮箱（Gmail、Outlook、任意IMAP账户），并配备可将个人号码与地址关联的联系人功能。连接ChatGPT即可搜索并阅读短信和邮件对话，分类线程，通过短信或邮件回复，并保持联系人信息整洁，所有操作均可从登录时选择的渠道发起。访问权限遵循你在工作区中的角色，且可随时断开连接。

payload.name: Avoma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your Avoma workspace and get meeting intelligence, including call transcripts, AI-generated notes, scorecard results, and usage analytics. Ask ChatGPT about stalled deals, review rep scorecards, track quota attainment, or walk into your next call with full account history.

Read capabilities:
- Meeting transcripts, structured notes, and AI summaries
- Scorecard evaluations and team usage / engagement metrics
- CRM deal stages, CRM associations, meeting outcomes, meeting types, and team listings

Write capabilities:
- Update meeting outcomes
- Set meeting privacy — private, organization, public, or team-scoped
- Assign meeting types / purposes

You can use the Avoma connector to:

- Review calls and action items:
 "Summarise my calls from last week and list open action items"
- Check team scorecards:
 "Show me scorecard results for the sales team this month and identify the three coaching areas with the lowest average scores."
- Find meetings by deal stage:
 "Find all meetings linked to Closed Won deals over $50,000 that closed in Q2 2026 and summarize the common buying signals."
- Update meeting outcomes:
 "Set the outcome of my demo call with Acme Corp from June 15 to Qualified"
- Manage meeting privacy:
 "Make all onboarding calls for the Globex account from the past 30 days visible only to the Customer Success team."
- Create a playbook:
 "Analyze win/loss calls for Enterprise deals over $100,000 that closed in the last two quarters and create a coaching playbook with examples of effective discovery questions, objection handling, and closing techniques."

Access is controlled by your Avoma permissions and OAuth 2.1 credentials. No meeting data is stored by ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:

你可以使用 Avoma 连接器完成以下任务：

“总结我上周的通话，并列出尚未完成的行动项。”

- 更新会议结果：

- 创建指导手册：

访问由你的 Avoma 权限和 OAuth 2.1 凭据控制。ChatGPT 不存储任何会议数据。

payload.name: Drag
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Drag is a shared inbox for Gmail teams. The addresses everyone answers, like support@, sales@ and info@, become boards the whole team works together, with assignment, labels, a help center, WhatsApp and response-time reporting. It runs inside Gmail and Google Workspace, so nobody has to learn a new inbox.

Connect Drag to ChatGPT and you can run that team inbox by asking. Triage what arrived overnight, draft a reply grounded in your own help center article, assign a conversation to a teammate, or turn a customer email into a task with a due date.

47 tools across 12 categories, with full read and write access:

Triage: list, search and filter email threads by column, assignee or label, and find what has waited longest for a reply.

Reply: draft and send responses grounded in your own help center articles, and leave internal comments for teammates.

Organize: assign conversations to teammates, add and remove labels and tags, and move threads between columns or boards.

Plan: turn customer emails into task cards with due dates and checklists, and move work across columns as it progresses.

WhatsApp: read conversations and send messages or approved templates alongside email.

Report: first response times, average response time, daily volume and closed-conversation counts.

Setup takes about two minutes: add the plugin, then enter your Drag API key once on a secure connect page. The key never appears in a web address and the connect service stores nothing. ChatGPT inherits your Drag permissions, and every action is attributed to you inside Drag where the whole team can see it. Reading never interrupts you; sending email or WhatsApp always asks first.

Requires a Drag account with API access. Open source, MIT licensed.
payload.longDescription:
Drag是Gmail团队的共享收件箱。所有人处理的邮箱地址，如support@、sales@和info@，会变成团队协作的看板，支持分配任务、添加标签、建立帮助中心、接入WhatsApp及回复时效报告。它直接运行在Gmail和Google Workspace内，无需团队成员学习新的收件箱系统。

将Drag连接至ChatGPT后，可通过提问管理团队收件箱。您可分类处理夜间积累的邮件、基于自有帮助中心文章起草回复、将对话分配给同事，或通过设定截止日期将客户邮件转为任务。

涵盖12个类别的47个工具，均提供完整的读写权限：

分类处理：通过栏目、负责人或标签筛选、搜索邮件线程，并查看等待回复时间最长的邮件。

回复管理：基于自有帮助中心文章起草并发送回复，并为同事留下内部评论。

整理优化：将对话分配给同事、添加/移除标签和标记，并在不同栏目或看板间移动邮件线程。

计划管理：将客户邮件转化为带截止日期和待办清单的任务卡片，并在工作推进时跨栏目移动任务。

WhatsApp：通过电子邮件同时阅读对话内容并发送消息或已批准的模板。

报告内容包括：首次响应时间、平均响应时间、每日消息量及已关闭对话数量。

设置过程约需两分钟：添加插件后，前往安全连接页面输入您的Drag API密钥。密钥永远不会出现在网址中，连接服务不会存储任何内容。ChatGPT将继承您的Drag权限，所有操作在Drag内都会标记为您的身份，团队成员均可查看。阅读操作不会打扰您；发送电子邮件或WhatsApp时总会先询问您。

需要拥有API访问权限的Drag账户。开源软件，采用MIT协议许可。

payload.name: camelBots
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
camelBots turns a description into a running Discord bot. Say what your bot should do, for example roll dice for game night, welcome new members or run a trivia round, and camel-builder, camelBots' builder, writes its code, tries it in a private test channel and saves it. Ask for changes in plain words; when you are happy, publish it and add it to your server with one link that opens Discord's own screen. camelBots hosts the bot for you: there is nothing to install or keep running.

It is for community owners, moderators and anyone who wants a custom bot without writing or hosting code.

The app acts only on the camelBots account you sign in with, and only on its bots. A bot stays a draft until you publish it, and adding it to a server always happens on Discord's screen, where you pick a server you manage. It never asks for Discord bot tokens or other credentials in the conversation: camelBots asks for them on its own pages. Deleting a bot is done in camelBots itself.
payload.longDescription:
camelBots能将描述转化为运行中的Discord机器人。描述你的机器人应执行的任务，例如为游戏之夜掷骰子、欢迎新成员或开展问答环节，camel-builder（camelBots的构建工具）会编写代码，在私有测试频道中进行测试并保存。用自然语言提出修改需求；确认无误后通过链接发布，并使用该链接直接打开Discord内置界面添加至你的服务器。camelBots会为你托管机器人：无需安装或维护任何内容。

适用于社区管理员、版主以及希望拥有定制机器人但无需编写或托管代码的用户。

该应用仅操作你登录的camelBots账户及其对应的机器人。机器人在发布前始终为草稿状态，添加至服务器的操作始终在Discord界面完成，需从你管理的服务器中选择。它不会在对话中请求Discord机器人令牌或其他凭证：camelBots会在其独立页面中获取这些信息。删除机器人需在camelBots平台内操作。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create a Discord bot from a description, Change a bot by describing what you want, List your bots and see where they are installed, Publish a bot, Get the link that adds a bot to your server

payload.name: Artil
payload.description: 为您的AI提供邮箱和电话
payload.summaryOriginal: Email and phone for your AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Artil gives ChatGPT its own identity with email address and phone number, separate from yours. Ask ChatGPT to email a restaurant about a booking, follow up with a supplier, or handle messages from a service you're signing up for. It can receive replies, read verification emails, and continue conversations without using your personal email.

Create an Agent Account in Artil and connect it to ChatGPT, giving your assistant a persistent identity to communicate with people and services on its own behalf. Use Artil in everyday ChatGPT chats, ChatGPT Work, or with dots to let your assistant communicate beyond ChatGPT.

Artil also connects ChatGPT to other AI agents in your company. Give each agent an Artil account and ChatGPT can contact it directly via URL, by email, or by text. For example, ask ChatGPT to request a monthly report from your sales agent and have that agent email the results to your team. Each agent keeps working wherever it already runs, with its own identity and communication channels.
payload.longDescription:
Artil为ChatGPT赋予独立的邮箱地址和电话号码，与您的个人信息分开。
可以让ChatGPT代您向餐厅发送预订邮件，跟进供应商或处理注册服务的沟通。
它能够接收回复、阅读验证邮件，并在不使用您个人邮箱的情况下持续对话。

在Artil中创建代理账户并连接至ChatGPT，为您的助手赋予持久身份，使其能够以独立身份与人员和服务进行沟通。
可在日常ChatGPT对话、ChatGPT工作场景中，或通过dots功能让助手突破ChatGPT限制进行沟通。

Artil还可将ChatGPT与公司内部的其他AI代理相连接。
为每个代理分配Artil账户后，ChatGPT可通过网址、邮件或短信直接与其联系。
例如，让ChatGPT向销售代理请求月度报告，并由该代理将结果邮件发送至您的团队。
每个代理仍可在原有运行环境中持续工作，保持独立身份和通信渠道。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Send email and texts, Read its inbox, Wait for replies

payload.name: FiraPhone
payload.description: 通过浏览器拨打语音电话
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your existing FiraPhone account to call supported landlines and mobile phones inside ChatGPT. Check the destination rate first, choose a maximum call length, then start the call yourself in the dialler. Includes microphone testing, speaker volume, mute, a touch-tone keypad and hang-up. See your balance and the final provider-confirmed charge. Requires an existing account with calling credit and a browser with microphone access. Emergency calls are not supported. No call recording, subscriptions or credit purchases in the plugin.
payload.longDescription: 使用现有FiraPhone账户在ChatGPT内部拨打支持的固话和手机。首先检查目的地费率，选择最大通话时长，然后在拨号器中自行发起通话。包含麦克风测试、扬声器音量调节、静音、拨号键盘和挂断功能。可查看账户余额及最终由供应商确认的费用。需要已开通通话信用额度的账户，以及支持麦克风访问的浏览器。不支持紧急呼叫，插件中不提供通话录音、订阅或信用额度购买功能。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check your FiraPhone calling balance, Check a phone number’s rate before calling, Make browser calls with microphone and audio controls, Read the confirmed call outcome and charge

payload.name: Rep
payload.description: 与经过认证的高管建立联系
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rep is an invitation-only social network for verified company executives in Japan. Connecting your Rep account lets ChatGPT work with the network you already belong to.

What you can do:
- Read the Rep board, where members post what they are looking for and what they can offer, and the timeline, where members share updates.
- Browse anonymous discussion threads, member profiles, and recently joined members.
- Find executives who match a need such as hiring, sales, partnerships, vendors, fundraising, or advice, with a short reason for each candidate.
- Publish a board post, timeline post, thread, or comment. These are visible to other Rep members.
- Save drafts to the approval queue in the Rep app. Drafts are not published until you approve them in the app.
- Send an introduction request to an executive. The recipient decides in the Rep app whether to connect.

Rep only accesses data available to your connected account. A Rep membership is required.
payload.longDescription:
Rep是面向日本经认证公司高管的邀请制社交网络。连接您的Rep账户后，ChatGPT即可与您所属的网络进行协作。

您可以：
- 浏览Rep动态板（成员发布需求与资源信息）和时间线（成员分享更新动态）
- 查看匿名讨论帖、成员资料及近期加入成员
- 根据招聘、销售、合作、供应商、融资或咨询等需求，查找匹配的高管，并附简要推荐理由
- 发布动态板帖文、时间线帖文、讨论帖或评论
（以上内容对其他Rep成员可见）
- 将草稿保存至Rep应用的审批队列
- 在应用中审批通过后才会发布草稿
- 向高管发送介绍请求
接收方将在Rep应用中决定是否建立连接。

Rep仅访问您已连接账户的数据。需拥有Rep会员资格。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find executives, Read the board and timeline, Publish posts, Save drafts for approval, Request introductions

payload.name: Send & Retain Emails
payload.description: 电子邮件模板与自动化
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Send & Retain is an email automation service. It creates, sends and tracks a company's transactional and marketing email — order confirmations, welcome emails, abandoned-cart reminders, win-back campaigns — and this plugin lets you run all of it from a conversation: the templates, the automations that send them, the contacts they go to, and the sending setup behind them.

Stand up a company's programme from its business type: a brand kit, starter templates and the matching automations (welcome, abandoned cart, order updates, win-back), created paused. Write and revise react.email templates in the company's own brand and voice, render them with sample data, and publish when they are right. Design event-triggered automations with delays, send windows, branches and A/B variants, preview every email in an automation, and check what would block it before it goes live. Manage contacts, attributes and segments, read delivery and engagement metrics by template and by day, search the message log, and triage bounces and complaints.

Built for founders, marketers and agencies running email for one company or a portfolio of them.

Safety by design: there is no bulk send. Every message has one recipient, and mail reaches many people only through an automation a person explicitly enabled. Automations are always created paused, and enabling one is a separate, confirmed step. Each company has a send kill switch and an optional daily cap. Bounces and complaints suppress addresses automatically, and complaint suppressions can never be removed. Provider API keys are entered only on the Send & Retain settings page, never in chat.

Limitations: email only (no SMS, push or social posting). Sending needs a connected provider or platform sending and a verified domain, which a person sets up once per company. Connecting requires a Send & Retain account.
payload.longDescription:
Send & Retain 是一项电子邮件自动化服务，可创建、发送并跟踪企业的交易类和营销类邮件——包括订单确认邮件、欢迎邮件、购物车遗弃提醒、客户召回活动——此插件可让你通过对话界面完成全部操作：模板管理、发送模板的自动化流程、目标联系人列表，以及背后的发送设置。

根据企业类型快速搭建邮件计划：品牌资料包、基础模板以及匹配的自动化流程（欢迎邮件、购物车遗弃提醒、订单更新、客户召回），所有流程初始状态均为暂停。可在企业自有品牌风格和语气下编写与修改 react.email 模板，使用示例数据预览效果，确认无误后发布。通过延迟、发送时段、分支逻辑和 A/B 测试变体设计事件触发自动化流程，预览自动化中的每封邮件，并在上线前检查可能阻塞发送的因素。管理联系人、属性和分组，按模板和日期查看送达与互动数据，搜索邮件日志，处理退信和投诉。

专为创始人、营销人员和代理机构设计，适用于单个企业或多个企业的邮件运营。

设计安全：不支持群发功能。每封邮件仅有一个收件人，邮件通过用户明确启用的自动化流程触达多人。所有自动化流程初始状态均为暂停，启用需单独确认。每个企业配备发送紧急关闭开关，并可设置每日发送上限。退信和投诉会自动屏蔽对应地址，投诉屏蔽记录无法解除。供应商 API 密钥仅在 Send & Retain 设置页面输入，不会通过聊天窗口传递。

限制条件：仅支持电子邮件（不支持短信、推送或社交媒体发布）。发送邮件需要连接供应商或平台进行发送，并需验证企业域名，每家企业需一次性完成设置。连接操作需要 Send & Retain 账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Brand kit and starter programme per company, Author, render and publish react.email templates, Event-triggered automations, created paused, Contacts, attributes and segments, Delivery and engagement metrics, Message log and deliverability triage, Sending setup: provider, domain, senders, API keys

payload.name: ChatRook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover public ChatRook video rooms directly in ChatGPT. Search by room title or slug, check recent participant counts, and get a link to open a room on ChatRook. Check a specific public room before opening it. No login is needed for public discovery. Joining happens on ChatRook and may require signing in or meeting access checks. Room names are user-generated, and recent presence does not guarantee a live conversation. This connector does not read private rooms, messages or recordings, create meetings, contact anyone, start calls, or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中直接发现ChatRook公共视频房间。通过房间标题或别名搜索，查看最近参与人数并获取ChatRook的房间链接。可在打开房间前查看特定公共房间信息。公共发现功能无需登录。加入操作在ChatRook平台进行，可能需要登录或通过会议访问验证。房间名称由用户生成，近期活跃记录不保证存在实时对话。该连接器不会读取私有房间/消息/录音，无法创建会议、联系任何人、发起通话或处理支付。

payload.name: Sendblue
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn customer conversations into sales with iMessage, RCS, and SMS. Send messages and read replies from your Sendblue workspace directly in ChatGPT. Get started with iMessage without A2P 10DLC approval.

Sendblue customers report 2x+ response rates and $2B+ in sales using the service.

Follow up with leads, pick up recent conversations, and check message delivery without leaving your chat. Ask Sendblue to find your sending numbers, show a contact’s recent messages, send a personal follow-up, or summarize your recent messaging performance.

Connect an existing Sendblue account, choose your workspace, and approve the permissions you want to share. Messages use Sendblue’s available iMessage, RCS, and SMS routing. You can disconnect at any time from Sendblue Connected Apps.
payload.longDescription:
通过iMessage、RCS和短信将客户对话转化为销售机会。
可在ChatGPT中直接从Sendblue工作区发送消息并阅读回复。

Sendblue客户使用该服务后报告回复率提升2倍以上，销售额达200多亿美元。

无需离开聊天界面即可跟进潜在客户、查看最近对话并检查消息传递情况。
可要求Sendblue查找您的发送号码、展示联系人最近的对话、发送个性化跟进消息或总结近期沟通表现。

连接现有Sendblue账户，选择您的工作区，并批准共享的权限。
消息将使用Sendblue提供的iMessage、RCS和短信路由功能。
可随时通过Sendblue Connected Apps断开连接。

payload.name: Lemma Telepath
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lemma Telepath connects your Telegram Business account to ChatGPT so your assistant can work with your own business conversations. Ask it to summarise a thread, find the message where a price or a deadline was agreed, read a screenshot a client sent, listen to a voice message as text, or draft and send a reply as you.

It is built on the official Telegram Business API: you add our bot as your Business chatbot in Telegram and grant it the rights you choose, so there is no MTProto user session and nothing is scraped. From that moment your 1:1 business messages are archived into an account that is yours alone — one isolated database per account, full-text searchable, including the text inside attachments and transcripts of voice and round-video messages.

You stay in control of what the assistant may do. Every capability — replies, media, notes, group archiving — is a switch you can turn off at any time from the bot, and sending is surfaced for your confirmation before anything reaches another person. You can erase everything you have stored with a single command.

Telepath is not end-to-end encrypted and we say so plainly: searching and transcribing require our servers to read your messages. Data is encrypted at rest with full-disk encryption, each account is physically isolated, and voice transcription is opt-in, disclosing the processor it uses before you turn it on. If you need a guarantee that no operator can ever read your data, the same connector can be self-hosted on your own machine.
payload.longDescription:
Lemma Telepath将您的Telegram商业账户连接至ChatGPT，让您的助手能够处理专属的业务对话。可让它总结对话线程、查找价格或截止日期达成的消息、查看客户发送的截图、将语音消息转为文字，或代为起草并发送回复。

它基于官方Telegram商业API开发：您可在Telegram中将我们的机器人添加为商业聊天机器人并授予所需权限，无需MTProto用户会话，也不会抓取任何数据。从此时起，您的1对1业务消息将归档至专属账户——每个账户拥有独立数据库，支持全文搜索，包含附件内文本及语音和视频消息的转录内容。

您始终掌握对助手操作的控制权。所有功能——回复、媒体处理、笔记记录、群组归档——都是可随时在机器人中关闭的开关，任何内容发送前都需要您确认。您可通过一条指令清除所有存储数据。

Telepath并非端到端加密，我们明确说明这一点：搜索和转录功能需要我们的服务器读取您的消息。数据以全盘加密方式存储，每个账户物理隔离，语音转录功能需用户主动开启，并会在启用前披露所用处理器。如需确保无任何操作员能读取您的数据，同一连接工具可自行托管在您的设备上。

payload.name: Mail Merge for Gmail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Send personalized email campaigns from Gmail, manage contacts and templates, and review campaign activity and analytics. Prepare each campaign with a preview and confirm before sending.
payload.longDescription: 通过Gmail发送个性化电子邮件活动，管理联系人和模板，并查看活动概览与分析数据。通过预览准备每场活动并在发送前确认。

payload.name: Kadenzo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kadenzo is a social media scheduler. Connect your Kadenzo account and ChatGPT can plan and schedule posts to the accounts you have linked in Kadenzo (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, YouTube, Mastodon and Telegram), with per-platform text, threads and media links.

Ask it to draft a post and schedule it for Tuesday at 9am, check whether a post fits each network's limits before it goes out, move or cancel something in your queue, see how your recent posts performed, find your best times to post from your own engagement history, or catch up on who is mentioning your brand.

Kadenzo always schedules for a future time and never publishes instantly, and ChatGPT asks you to confirm before anything is scheduled, changed or cancelled. You need a Kadenzo account with at least one social account connected. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time under Settings → API keys in Kadenzo.
payload.longDescription:
Kadenzo是一款社交媒体调度工具，连接您的Kadenzo账户后，ChatGPT可以为您计划并安排已连接账户（Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、LinkedIn、X、Threads、Bluesky、Pinterest、YouTube、Mastodon和Telegram）的帖子，支持各平台的文字、话题和媒体链接

Kadenzo始终安排未来时间发布，从不立即推送，且在任何内容被安排、修改或取消前会向您确认。您需要拥有已连接至少一个社交账户的Kadenzo账户，可在Kadenzo的设置→API密钥中随时断开ChatGPT连接

payload.name: Missive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and read conversations across your connected Missive accounts, find contacts and team inboxes, draft and send messages, and organize conversations with labels. You can also view and manage connected calendar events. Access follows your Missive account permissions, organization settings, and granted OAuth scopes.

payload.name: DataFlows SMS

Send and manage business SMS from your DataFlows account, in plain language.

• Send campaigns to your DataFlows contact groups

Built-in safeguards

• A group send must match the recipient count you previewed

Requires a DataFlows account (sms.dataflows.com.au).
payload.longDescription:
通过您的DataFlows账户以自然语言发送和管理业务短信。

隐私保护

显示联系人分组名称和规模，永不显示具体联系人信息。

需要DataFlows账户（sms.dataflows.com.au）。

payload.name: TellTell
payload.description: 管理团队电子邮件列表
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage the people and memberships behind your team’s group email lists. TellTell provides dedicated group email addresses for teams, schools, clubs, and organizations, so members can communicate from their usual email inboxes.

Connect your TellTell Admin account to find and update people, see which groups they belong to, organize overlapping teams and groups, manage custom fields and tags, and preview roster imports or membership changes before applying them.

You choose the connected account and permissions. Bulk editing starts disabled and requires an Admin to enable it. Membership changes may send configured welcome emails, and some person or settings changes may trigger automatic-photo lookups.

This plugin manages your TellTell directory and groups. It does not read your Gmail or Outlook inbox, send standalone emails, manage billing, or grant account-user access.
payload.longDescription:
管理团队群组邮件列表中的成员信息。
TellTell为团队、学校、俱乐部和组织提供专用群组电子邮件地址，让成员能够通过常规电子邮件收件箱进行沟通。

将您的TellTell管理员账户进行连接，可查找并更新人员信息，查看其所属群组，整理重叠的团队和群组，管理自定义字段和标签，并在应用前预览人员名单导入或会员变更。

您可自行设置连接账户和权限。
批量编辑功能默认关闭，需管理员手动启用。
会员变更可能触发配置的欢迎邮件，部分人员信息或设置变更可能激活自动照片检索。

此插件用于管理您的TellTell通讯录和群组。
它不会读取您的Gmail或Outlook收件箱，不会独立发送邮件，不处理账单管理，也不提供账户用户访问权限。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Manage group email lists, Manage people and memberships, Preview roster changes

payload.name: Realtime Avatar
payload.description: 实时AI虚拟形象视频通话功能
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Realtime Avatar (RTA) brings live, interactive AI avatar video conversations to ChatGPT. Talk by voice or text, choose a conversation topic, and control your session from a single view. Powered by realtimeavatar.ai.
payload.longDescription:
Realtime Avatar（RTA）将实时互动的AI虚拟形象视频对话功能带入ChatGPT。
通过语音或文字交谈，选择对话主题，并通过单一视图控制您的会话。
由realtimeavatar.ai提供支持。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find the available AI avatar, Set up an avatar conversation with an optional topic, Start and end a live avatar video call, Read the current session status, Return a session-completion message after an explicit user action

payload.name: teem
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: teem is customer support and feedback software for product teams. It gives a team one inbox for customer chat, a public board where customers request and vote on features, a changelog, and a help center. With this plugin, a team member can ask ChatGPT who is waiting for a reply, what customers ask for most, and what shipped, then have it draft replies, changelog entries and help articles from that data. Replies, status changes and publishing happen only after the team member approves them. When a request ships, teem emails every customer who voted for it.
payload.longDescription: teem 是面向产品团队的客户支持与反馈软件。它为团队提供统一的客户聊天邮箱、一个客户可请求并投票选择功能的公共看板、更新日志和帮助中心。通过此插件，团队成员可以向ChatGPT询问哪些客户等待回复、客户最常请求什么以及哪些功能已发布，然后根据这些数据生成回复、更新日志条目和帮助文章。回复、状态更改和发布仅在团队成员批准后进行。当请求被发布时，teem 会向所有投票支持该请求的客户发送邮件。

payload.name: Fanaura
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Instagram DM automation for creators and musicians. Fanaura runs when someone comments or DMs your keyword on Instagram, or texts or emails that word, not on every message. Fanaura sends your link, can ask for an email or phone number, then takes them to the destination URL you chose. The contact stays on your account, with the visit and the answers on their timeline. You set the keyword, the public replies, and the destination in a few messages here, and you can open the same journey in the Fanaura iPhone app when you want the visual builder.
payload.longDescription: 为创作者和音乐人提供的Instagram私信自动化工具。当有人在Instagram上评论或发送包含您关键词的私信，或在短信、电子邮件中出现该关键词时（并非针对每条消息），Fanaura会触发响应。该工具会发送您的链接，可要求用户提供邮箱或电话号码，随后将其引导至您选择的目标网址。联系人信息保留在您的账户中，包括访问记录和回复内容均显示在其动态中。您可以通过几条消息在此设置关键词、公开回复内容及目标网址，当需要使用可视化构建器时，还可通过Fanaura的iPhone应用开启相同的流程。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Comment-to-DM on a keyword, Auto-reply in comments and DM the link, Email capture before your link, See who opened your journeys

payload.name: Cadencz
payload.description: 规划和安排社交媒体帖子
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cadencz is a social media manager for founders and small teams: it plans, writes and schedules social media posts for your business. Connect your Cadencz account and ask ChatGPT to plan your week of posts, draft a post for LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky and more, show this week's content plan, or check how much of your plan you have used. Every post is grounded in what Cadencz learned about your business from your website and written in your own voice. Drafts are saved to your Cadencz workspace for review; nothing is published or scheduled without your confirmation.
payload.longDescription: Cadencz是创始人和小团队的社交媒体管理工具：它为您的企业规划、撰写并安排社交媒体帖子。连接您的Cadencz账户，让ChatGPT帮您规划一周的帖子，为领英、X、Threads、Bluesky等平台撰写内容，展示本周的内容计划，或查看您已使用计划的百分比。每篇帖子都基于Cadencz从您的网站中了解的业务信息，并以您自己的语气撰写。草稿会保存到您的Cadencz工作区以供审阅；未经您的确认，不会发布或安排任何内容。

payload.name: Infobip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get guidance on customer messaging implementation choices and best practices, including requirements by country and channel. Send with Infobip, then track trends in volume, delivery, costs, errors, and engagement metrics.
payload.longDescription: 获取客户消息实施选择和最佳实践的指导，包括各国和渠道的要求。通过Infobip发送，然后跟踪数量、交付、成本、错误和参与度指标的趋势。

payload.name: MBX Reach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MBX Reach is an email marketing tool for creators, brands, shops and growing teams: newsletters, email campaigns, contacts and mailing lists. Connect it and ask in plain words: ChatGPT looks people up in your audience, adds the people who asked to hear from you, tags them and puts them on mailing lists, writes email campaign drafts in your brand's design, checks whether a draft is ready to go, and reads your campaign reports (opens and clicks). ChatGPT never sends: every draft waits in MBX Reach until you review it and press Send. There is no tool to delete anything.
payload.longDescription: MBX Reach是创作者、品牌、店铺和成长型团队的电子邮件营销工具：新闻通讯、电子邮件活动、联系人和邮件列表。连接它并用简单明了的语言提问：ChatGPT会查找受众中的人员，将那些希望收到你消息的人添加进来，打标签并将其加入邮件列表，按照品牌设计撰写电子邮件活动草稿，检查草稿是否准备就绪，并阅读您的活动报告（打开和点击情况）。ChatGPT从不自动发送：每个草稿都会在MBX Reach中等待，直到您审查并点击发送。没有删除任何内容的工具。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find contacts and see their lists and tags, Add people who asked to join and put them on lists, Write and edit campaign drafts (never sends), Check whether a draft is ready and read campaign reports

payload.name: Consensus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Consensus is the go-to MCP for academic research. Connect directly to 220M+ peer-reviewed papers to search, synthesize, and build structured research outputs from within your conversation.

Run literature reviews, build boolean search strategies, generate bibliographies, identify research gaps, and draft cited content — grounded in studies from PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and ArXiv. Pre-built workflows handle complex tasks in minutes: systematic reviews, curriculum reading lists, grant research with novelty analysis, and clinical evidence synthesis.

Built for researchers, students, faculty, and clinicians across biomedical, social science, STEM, and all academic disciplines.
payload.longDescription:
Consensus 是学术研究的首选 MCP。直接连接至 2.2 亿+ 篇同行评审论文，在对话中搜索、整合并构建结构化研究输出。

执行文献综述、构建布尔搜索策略、生成参考文献列表、识别研究空白并撰写引用内容——基于 PubMed、Semantic Scholar 和 ArXiv 的研究。预设工作流程可在数分钟内完成复杂任务：系统综述、课程阅读清单、包含新颖性分析的资助研究以及临床证据整合。

专为生物医学、社会科学、STEM（科学、技术、工程、数学）及所有学术领域的研究人员、学生、教职员工和临床医生打造。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search research papers, Read paper details

payload.name: Explain Video Generator
payload.description: 免费 AI 讲解视频制作工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn anything into a narrated explainer video, without leaving ChatGPT. Free to start, no login required.

Give it a topic, a document, a webpage, a codebase or a product brief, and Explain turns it into a video in your language — with voiceover, diagrams, animations and images, plus real code walkthroughs when you need them. 

Add your own images and screenshots and they go straight in. Share with a link or download the video file.

How you can use Explain:

* Onboard new employees without filming a thing
* Study a difficult subject before an exam, in the language you think in
* Walk your team through a pull request or codebase
* Show customers how your product works, using your own screenshots
* Make the same video in 40+ languages from a single document
* Start your class with a 3-minute lesson opener built from the textbook chapter
* Paste any web link to get a narrated video explanation
* Turn a long ChatGPT conversation into a video you can rewatch or share
* Create a bedtime story for your child

Want to make it your own? Keep editing on our platform, then combine your explainers into full courses and playlists.

Powered by Scrimba, a learning platform with over 2 million users.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可将任何内容转换为配有旁白的讲解视频。免费开始，无需登录。

提供一个主题、文档、网页、代码库或产品简介，Explain 就会用你的语言将其制作成视频，包含配音、图表、动画和图像；需要时还可以逐步讲解真实代码。

添加自己的图像和屏幕截图，它们会直接加入视频。通过链接分享或下载视频文件。

Explain 的用途：

* 无需拍摄即可为新员工提供入职培训
* 用你熟悉的语言，在考试前学习难懂的主题
* 向团队讲解拉取请求或代码库
* 使用自己的屏幕截图向客户展示产品的工作方式
* 根据一份文档制作 40 多种语言版本的同一视频
* 将教材章节制作成 3 分钟课程开场内容
* 粘贴任意网页链接，生成带旁白的视频讲解
* 将冗长的 ChatGPT 对话转成可重看或分享的视频
* 为孩子创作睡前故事

想进一步定制？可在我们的平台继续编辑，并将多个讲解视频组合成完整课程和播放列表。

由 Scrimba 提供支持，这是一个拥有超过 200 万用户的学习平台。

payload.name: Acumen by Talarion
payload.description: 让 AI 掌握最新信息
payload.summaryOriginal: Keep your AI up to date.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Talarion keeps AI current. Frontier models don't know about recent events, and web search can't answer questions LLMs don't know to ask. Talarion proactively tells your AI what it's missing before it starts researching to prevent critical omissions and judgement errors. Install the MCP to make sure your AI assistant knows what it would otherwise be missing.
payload.longDescription: Talarion 让 AI 保持与时俱进。前沿模型不了解近期事件，网页搜索也无法回答 LLM 不知道该问的问题。Talarion 在 AI 开始研究前主动告知其缺失的信息，避免关键遗漏和判断错误。安装 MCP，确保你的 AI 助手知道原本会遗漏的内容。

payload.name: SciSpace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SciSpace for ChatGPT supports the core tasks of research: discovery, triage, and synthesis.

Use it to search for academic papers and review them in a customizable table with metadata and links. Add structured columns - abstract, summary, methods, results, conclusions - to quickly assess relevance and quality. Then use the collected list as the basis for literature review notes, thematic synthesis, and targeted follow-up searches.

Get started with prompts like: 
1.  "SciSpace Find papers on impact of nanoplastics on gut health"
2. "SciSpace How does climate change impact biodiversity?"
payload.longDescription:
SciSpace for ChatGPT 支持研究的核心任务：发现、筛选和综合。

使用它搜索学术论文，并在可自定义的表格中通过元数据和链接进行审阅。添加结构化列——摘要、概要、方法、结果、结论——以便快速评估相关性和质量。随后可将收集的列表用于撰写文献综述笔记、主题综合和有针对性的后续搜索。

可以尝试以下提示：
1. “SciSpace 查找有关纳米塑料对肠道健康影响的论文”
2. “SciSpace 气候变化如何影响生物多样性？”

payload.name: Scite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: scite helps users search and read scientific papers, inspect citation context and citation graphs, format bibliographies, record citation decisions, and organize papers and notes in Collections through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: scite 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索和阅读科学论文、查看引用上下文和引用关系图、格式化参考书目、记录引用决策，并在 Collections 中整理论文和笔记。

payload.name: Quizlet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Using the Quizlet app in ChatGPT, you can instantly create flashcards from any prompt or file. Just ask for a set on any topic, upload your notes, or describe what you need and we'll handle the formatting and generation for you. No more copying, pasting, or switching tabs. Create, customize, and study all from one place. Whether you're prepping for an exam or building a set between classes, Quizlet in ChatGPT helps you skip the busywork and stay focused on learning.
payload.longDescription: 使用 ChatGPT 中的 Quizlet 应用，你可以根据任何提示或文件即时创建抽认卡。只需提出任何主题的抽认卡需求、上传笔记或描述你的需要，我们就会为你处理格式和生成。无需再复制、粘贴或切换标签页。在一个地方即可创建、自定义并学习。无论你是在准备考试，还是课间想创建一组卡片，ChatGPT 中的 Quizlet 都能帮你省去繁琐工作，专注学习。

payload.name: Wolfram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Wolfram MCP Server transforms your AI environment into a rigorous computational powerhouse. By integrating Wolfram Language and Wolfram|Alpha, this server provides access to curated data and sophisticated algorithms. When a user submits a query, the LLM works with Wolfram to convert it into Wolfram Language for precise evaluation, and these exact results are incorporated into the response provided by the LLM.

Whether you are solving complex differential equations, analyzing chemical structures or querying real-time socioeconomic data, the MCP Server ensures your AI has the "computational brain" necessary to deliver verified, high-level technical results that can be trusted.
payload.longDescription:
Wolfram MCP Server 将你的 AI 环境变成严谨的计算平台。它集成 Wolfram Language 和 Wolfram|Alpha，可访问精选数据与复杂算法。用户提交问题后，LLM 会与 Wolfram 协作，将问题转换为 Wolfram Language 并进行精确计算，再将准确结果纳入回复。

无论是求解复杂微分方程、分析化学结构，还是查询实时社会经济数据，MCP Server 都能为 AI 提供所需的“计算大脑”，从而给出经过验证、值得信赖的高水平技术结果。

payload.name: Tarteel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tarteel brings deep Quranic study into ChatGPT. Read any ayah with translations from 50+ languages or detailed tafsir commentary from 20+ scholarly collections. Search the Quran by Arabic text with diacritic-insensitive matching, explore repeated phrases (mutashabihat) across the Mushaf, and listen to recitations by 17+ renowned reciters including Al-Husary, Al-Minshawi, and Abdul Basit. Get accurate Islamic prayer times for any city worldwide. Every piece of content is drawn from verified scholarly sources — trustworthy, faithful to the tradition, and ready whenever you need it.
payload.longDescription: Tarteel 将深入的古兰经研读带入 ChatGPT。阅读任意一节经文，并查看 50+ 种语言的译文，或来自 20+ 个学者文集的详细经注。通过不受变音符号影响的匹配方式按阿拉伯语文本搜索古兰经，探索《穆斯哈夫》中反复出现的短语（mutashabihat），并收听 17+ 位著名诵读者的诵读，包括 Al-Husary、Al-Minshawi 和 Abdul Basit。查询全球任意城市准确的伊斯兰礼拜时间。所有内容均来自经过验证的学术来源，可信、忠实于传统，并随时可供你查阅。

payload.name: Kahoot!
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Transform any topic, document, or link into a live, interactive learning session in seconds. Upload a PDF, paste meeting notes, or describe your idea, and AI will automatically generate a ready-to-play multiple-choice activity tailored to your needs—whether you're a teacher designing formative assessments, a manager running zero-prep icebreakers, or a student creating personalized flashcards.

Onboarding prompts:
“Turn my study notes into a kahoot I can practice with”
“Make a 10-question game from this article”
“Create a quick knowledge check for my team”
“Build an onboarding kahoot for new employees”
“Create an icebreaker game for a team meeting”

Category tags:
Quiz Maker, Interactive Quiz, Formative Assessment, Employee Training, Engagement, Education, Study Tools, Trivia, Team Meeting, Test Prep
payload.longDescription:
几秒钟内即可将任意主题、文档或链接转化为实时互动学习活动。上传 PDF、粘贴会议记录或描述你的想法，AI 就会自动生成适合你需求、可立即开始的选择题活动——无论你是设计形成性评估的教师、组织零准备破冰活动的经理，还是制作个性化记忆卡片的学生。

引导提示：
“把我的学习笔记做成一个我可以练习的 kahoot”
“根据这篇文章制作一个 10 题的游戏”
“为我的团队创建一个快速知识测验”
“为新员工制作入职 kahoot”
“为团队会议创建一个破冰游戏”

类别标签：
测验制作、互动测验、形成性评估、员工培训、参与度、教育、学习工具、知识问答、团队会议、考试备考

payload.name: AhaMotion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AhaMotion turns complex topics into clear, animated explanations. Whether you are tackling K-12 assignments or just curious about the world, simply ask and view the concept visually.

1. Universal Concept Visualizer
Curious about “Why volcanoes erupt” or “How rain forms”? We break down general knowledge into easy-to-watch video summaries.

2. K-12 Science & Math Tutor
Visual Math Solver: Watch how functions graph and how geometric shapes transform to better understand Algebra and Geometry logic.
Science Visualization: Visualize concepts in Physics, Biology, Chemistry and related subjects.

3. General Learning Support
Turn study sessions into engaging visual stories. It acts as a tutor that draws key ideas out to support understanding and review.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect AhaMotion to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type "@AhaMotion"
Sample Prompts：
"@AhaMotion Generate a short educational video explaining how photosynthesis works."
"@AhaMotion Generate a video explaining Euler’s formula and its geometric meaning."
"@AhaMotion Create a video that explains the Pythagorean theorem for middle school students."
payload.longDescription:
AhaMotion将复杂主题转化为清晰的动画解释。无论您在处理K-12作业还是单纯对世界充满好奇，只需提问即可通过视觉化方式观看概念解析。

1. 通用概念可视化工具 想知道「为什么火山会喷发」或「雨水是如何形成的」吗？我们将通用知识分解为易于观看的视频摘要。

2. K-12科学与数学辅导 视觉数学求解器：观看函数图像变化及几何图形转换，更好理解代数和几何逻辑。科学可视化：可视化物理、生物、化学及相关学科的概念。

3. 通用学习支持 将学习环节转化为引人入胜的视觉故事。它像导师一样提取关键概念，支持理解和复习。

如何在ChatGPT中使用 1. 连接应用：将AhaMotion连接至ChatGPT。 2. 触发指令：输入「@AhaMotion」 示例提示： 「@AhaMotion 生成一个简短的教育视频解释光合作用的工作原理。」 「@AhaMotion 生成一个视频解释欧拉公式及其几何意义。」 「@AhaMotion 为中学生创建一个解释毕达哥拉斯定理的视频。」

payload.name: CourtListener
payload.description: 人人皆可进行法律研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to CourtListener, the Free Law Project's legal research platform, with access to millions of U.S. court opinions, PACER dockets, judge profiles, oral arguments, and citation data. Search case law across federal and state courts, retrieve full case metadata, extract and verify legal citations against a canonical database, and set up alerts for new opinions or docket updates. Built and operated by Free Law Project, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to making the law broadly accessible. Suited for attorneys, legal researchers, journalists, academics, and pro se litigants who need fast, reliable access to primary legal sources.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Free Law Project 的法律研究平台 CourtListener，即可访问数百万份美国法院判决、PACER 案件档案、法官资料、口头辩论记录和引证数据。搜索联邦及州法院判例法，获取完整案件元数据，从权威数据库中提取并核验法律引证，并为新判决或案件档案更新设置提醒。CourtListener 由 Free Law Project 创建并运营；该组织是致力于让公众广泛获取法律信息的 501(c)(3) 非营利机构。适合法律从业者、法律研究人员、记者、学者和自行诉讼当事人快速可靠地访问一手法律资料。

payload.name: Wayground
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wayground helps teachers and students turn teaching and learning materials into ready-to-assign quizzes and study cards. Paste or reference instructional content, and Wayground generates aligned questions and flashcards directly from it — no need to rewrite lessons as assessments. Teachers use it to save prep time and quickly check understanding. Students use it to practice and self-check from the same material. Generated activities are delivered through Wayground, with reporting so teachers can see how students are engaging and where they need support.
payload.longDescription: Wayground 帮助教师和学生将教学与学习材料转化为可直接布置的测验和学习卡片。粘贴或引用教学内容，Wayground 就会据此生成相匹配的问题和单词卡，无需把课程内容重新改写成考题。教师可以节省备课时间，并快速检查学生是否理解；学生则可以用同一份材料练习和自测。生成的学习活动通过 Wayground 发布，并附有报告，让教师了解学生的参与情况以及他们需要帮助的地方。

payload.name: Transkriptor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Transkriptor brings your transcription library into ChatGPT.

Work with the transcripts and recordings already in your Transkriptor account—
list them, read the full text, get AI-generated summaries, download as PDF, 
and check your account details, all from a chat conversation.

Key features:

- Browse transcripts: List and filter your transcriptions by file name keyword, 
  date range, or duration.
- Read full transcripts: Fetch the complete transcript content, including 
  speaker labels and timestamps.
- AI summaries: Get concise, structured summaries of meetings, interviews, 
  lectures, podcasts, and other recorded content.
- PDF export: Generate a downloadable PDF of any transcript.
- Account overview: Check remaining transcription minutes, subscription plan, 
  and language preference.

To create new transcriptions, use Transkriptor on the web (transkriptor.com), 
iOS, or Android. Once a transcription exists in your account, this connector 
makes it easy to find, read, summarize, and share through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Transkriptor 将你的转录资料库带入 ChatGPT。

在聊天中即可处理 Transkriptor 账户中已有的转录文本和录音——列出文件、阅读全文、获取 AI 生成的摘要、下载 PDF，并查看账户详情。

主要功能：

- 浏览转录文件：按文件名关键词、日期范围或时长列出并筛选转录内容。
- 阅读完整转录：获取完整转录内容，包括说话人标签和时间戳。
- AI 摘要：为会议、访谈、讲座、播客和其他录音生成简洁、有条理的摘要。
- 导出 PDF：为任意转录文本生成可下载的 PDF。
- 账户概览：查看剩余转录分钟数、订阅方案和语言偏好。

如需创建新的转录，请在网页端 (transkriptor.com)、iOS 或 Android 上使用 Transkriptor。转录内容保存到账户后，此连接器便可让你通过 ChatGPT 轻松查找、阅读、总结和分享。

payload.name: MetaMetrics® Lexile Analyzer
payload.description: 生成 Lexile 文本难度量值
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Measure the complexity of any text and receive its Lexile® measure in seconds. You can also use AI-powered text adaptation to increase or decrease the text’s complexity while preserving its meaning, helping you create versions that are more accessible or more challenging for different readers.
payload.longDescription: 只需几秒钟即可测量任意文本的复杂程度并获得其 Lexile® 量值。你还可以使用 AI 文本改写功能，在保留原意的同时提高或降低文本复杂度，为不同读者创建更易读或更具挑战性的版本。

payload.name: Language Coach: English
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LangCoach helps you check your English level with a placement test and see your CEFR band (A1–C1). Open the app in chat to take the test, review your score breakdown, and keep your level saved to your account. More practice modes are coming soon.
payload.longDescription: LangCoach 可通过分级测试检查你的英语水平，并显示对应的 CEFR 等级（A1–C1）。在聊天中打开应用参加测试、查看分数明细，并将等级保存到你的账户。更多练习模式即将推出。

payload.name: Elicit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Elicit's MCP server gives AI assistants direct access to a corpus of over 125 million academic papers. Search for relevant literature using natural language queries, create structured reports that extract and synthesize data across papers, and retrieve detailed report results — all programmatically. Built for life sciences R&D workflows, the server enables agents to rapidly survey evidence, compare findings across studies, and surface key data points without manual literature review, accelerating everything from target discovery to systematic evidence assessment.
payload.longDescription: Elicit 的 MCP 服务器让 AI 助手能够直接访问包含超过 125 百万篇学术论文的语料库。使用自然语言查询搜索相关文献，创建跨论文提取和综合数据的结构化报告，并以编程方式检索详细报告结果。该服务器面向生命科学研发工作流，让代理能够快速梳理证据、比较研究发现并提取关键数据点，无需人工逐篇审查，从而加快从靶点发现到系统性证据评估的各项工作。

payload.name: Legal Data Hunter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Legal Data Hunter connects ChatGPT to the world's fastest-growing open legal corpus — a continuously-updated index of 32M+ documents from 180+ jurisdictions. LDH ingests directly from official registries — Légifrance, BOE, EUR-Lex, RIS, the Bundesgerichtshof, the European Court of Human Rights, and hundreds more — and exposes them through a focused tool surface: hybrid semantic + keyword search, citation resolution (ECLI, CELEX, case numbers, article references with 95% accuracy across 184 sources), full-text retrieval, and discovery tools that tell the assistant what we have for a jurisdiction before it queries.

Free tier covers 20 searches/day for punctual research needs; paid plans scale to 100,000/month. Used by lawyers, paralegals, and legal-tech builders worldwide.
payload.longDescription:
Legal Data Hunter 将 ChatGPT 连接到全球增长最快的开放法律语料库之一——持续更新的索引包含来自 180+ 个司法辖区的 32M+ 份文档。LDH 直接从官方登记机构（包括 Légifrance、BOE、EUR-Lex、RIS、Bundesgerichtshof、欧洲人权法院等数百个来源）采集数据，并通过专门的工具提供混合语义与关键词搜索、引证解析（在 184 个来源中对 ECLI、CELEX、案号和条款引文的准确率为 95%）、全文检索，以及查询前先了解某个司法辖区有哪些资料的发现工具。

免费套餐每天可进行 20 次搜索，适用于临时研究需求；付费套餐最高支持每月 100,000 次搜索。全球律师、律师助理和法律科技开发者都在使用。

payload.name: Self Plagiarism Checker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WordBinary Self Plagiarism Checker opens an interactive widget where users can paste two documents and identify repeated phrase combinations. It highlights matching phrases of four or more consecutive words, shows a similarity percentage, and lists matched phrase combinations for quick writing review. Pasted text is processed inside the widget UI and is not stored by the MCP server.
payload.longDescription: WordBinary Self Plagiarism Checker 会打开一个交互式 widget，用户可以粘贴两份文档并识别重复的短语组合。它会高亮显示连续四个或更多单词相同的短语，显示相似度百分比，并列出匹配的短语组合，便于快速检查写作内容。粘贴的文本在 widget 界面内处理，不会由 MCP 服务器存储。

payload.name: Strive PDF Generator
payload.description: 将 LaTeX 转为 PDF 和数学练习册
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create, edit, and download professional PDFs with graphs and math notation — all without leaving ChatGPT.
Describe what you need in plain language or use the built-in LaTeX editor, then download the final PDF instantly.

Example Prompts
  • Teachers:
"Create a quadratic equations worksheet PDF with 10 questions and include an answer key."

No more copying LaTeX into external tools. Edit, recompile, and refine PDFs entirely within ChatGPT. Advanced users can open the PDF in full screen to manually edit and recompile the LaTeX — all in one place.

Key Features
  • Natural language input – Just describe what you want to create
  • LaTeX-powered formatting – Clean, professional math notation
  • Instant PDF generation – Download your PDF in seconds
  • Flexible viewing options – Full-screen, distraction-free PDF and LaTeX view
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可创建、编辑和下载带有图表与数学符号的专业 PDF。
用日常语言描述需求，或使用内置的 LaTeX 编辑器，然后立即下载最终 PDF。

示例提示
  • 教师：
“创建一份包含 10 道题并附答案的二次方程练习册 PDF。”
  • 家长：
“这是我女儿的数学考试。请创建一份针对她需要提升的部分设计题目的数学练习册 PDF。”
  • 学生：
“创建一份聚焦运动学的 IB 物理模拟考试 PDF。”
  • 教授：
“把这份摘要和引言排版成双栏 IEEE 风格的 PDF，并预留引文占位符。”
  • 专业人士：
“根据以下 LinkedIn 数据制作一份 PDF 简历。”
  • 开发者：
“编译这段 LaTeX 代码并生成精美的 PDF。”

无需再把 LaTeX 复制到外部工具。在 ChatGPT 中即可完成 PDF 的编辑、重新编译和润色。高级用户可以全屏打开 PDF，手动编辑并重新编译 LaTeX，所有操作都在同一处完成。

主要功能
  • 自然语言输入 – 只需描述你想创建的内容
  • LaTeX 驱动的排版 – 清晰、专业的数学符号
  • 即时生成 PDF – 几秒钟即可下载 PDF
  • 灵活的查看方式 – 全屏、无干扰的 PDF 和 LaTeX 视图

payload.name: Midpage Legal Research: US Law
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to an enterprise-grade database of case law, statutes, regulations, dockets, and more to enable complex legal research and writing workflows inside of ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 连接至包含判例法、法规、规章、案件档案等的企业级数据库，支持在ChatGPT内开展复杂的法律研究和写作工作流程。

payload.name: alphaXiv
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: alphaXiv helps users discover academic papers, read and query paper content, inspect linked GitHub repositories, and manage folders of saved papers through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: alphaXiv 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 发现学术论文，阅读和查询论文内容，查看关联的 GitHub 仓库，并管理已保存论文的文件夹。

payload.name: AnyLessonPlan for Teachers
payload.description: 为学校和班级生成教学内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AnyLessonPlan is a simple easy tool to help ChatGPT generate lesson plans!

e.g.

- "@AnyLessonPlan, I need to teach number bonds to my Grade 1 class"
- "Use @AnyLessonPlan to prepare a lesson on short story writing for my 12 year old class"

or, upload your lesson plan and ask

"This needs to be 20m shorter. Use @AnyLessonPlan"
payload.longDescription:
AnyLessonPlan 是一款简单易用的工具，帮助 ChatGPT 生成教案！

例如：

- “@AnyLessonPlan，我需要教 1 年级学生学习数的分解与组合”
- “使用 @AnyLessonPlan 为我的 12 岁学生准备一堂短篇小说写作课”

或者上传教案，然后提出请求

“这需要缩短 20m。使用 @AnyLessonPlan”

payload.name: Audioscrape
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Transcribe any recording, or search millions of moments from podcasts, city-council and county meetings, and Supreme Court hearings — with new episodes and meetings added every day.

Attach an audio file in the chat, or paste a direct link or a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link, and get a private, speaker-attributed transcript you can question. Every recording you add goes into your own workspace, where the people, companies, and topics in it are linked into a knowledge graph — so the tenth recording is searchable alongside the first.

Ask what was said about anything and get answers with the speaker, the exact timestamp, and a link that jumps to the moment. Track what any person, company, or topic has said across every episode and every recording of your own.
payload.longDescription:
转写任何录音，或搜索播客、市议会及县级会议、最高法院听证中的数百万个片段——每天都有新节目和会议加入。

在聊天中附加音频文件，或粘贴直接链接、Google Drive、Dropbox 或 OneDrive 分享链接，即可获得标注说话人的私密转写文本，并针对内容提问。你添加的每段录音都会进入自己的工作区，其中的人物、公司和主题会关联成知识图谱——因此第十段录音可以与第一段一起搜索。

询问任何话题曾被如何讨论，获得包含说话人、精确时间戳及直达对应时刻链接的答案。追踪任何人物、公司或主题在每集节目以及你自己的每段录音中的相关发言。

payload.name: StudyMe.ai
payload.description: 教育：用 1 个链接授课
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StudyMe.ai turns your teaching ideas into interactive lessons in seconds.
It is completely free to create and share lessons with students. Tell StudyMe.ai what you want to teach — including topic, level, and goal — and it creates a ready-to-use lesson webpage your students can open from a single link.
Teachers can easily refine each lesson by prompting ChatGPT or by adjusting the final result with editing tools on StudyMe.ai.
Students learn actively through quizzes, calculations, drag-and-drop exercises, clear explanations, and instant positive feedback. The varied tasks help increase engagement, improve focus, and support deeper learning.
Lessons can be shared instantly via unique links, with no login required for students.
Ideal for teachers, tutors, and educators who want to create high-quality lessons quickly and easily.
payload.longDescription:
StudyMe.ai 可以在几秒钟内把你的教学构想变成互动课程。
创建课程并与学生分享完全免费。告诉 StudyMe.ai 你想教什么，包括主题、级别和目标，它就会生成一个可直接使用的课程网页，学生通过一个链接即可打开。
教师可以通过向 ChatGPT 提示来轻松完善课程，也可以使用 StudyMe.ai 的编辑工具调整最终结果。
学生通过测验、计算、拖放练习、清晰讲解和即时积极反馈主动学习。多样化的任务有助于提高参与度、增强专注力并促进深入学习。
课程可通过专属链接即时分享，学生无需登录。
非常适合希望快速创建高质量课程的教师、辅导老师和教育工作者。

payload.name: Wiley Scholar Gateway
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wiley Scholar Gateway enables ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in peer-reviewed sources with verifiable citations and DOI links. The Wiley Scholar Gateway Connector searches literature from Wiley journals to deliver evidence-backed answers with complete source metadata. This enables you to verify that claims are backed with sourced research — ensuring your research meets professional research standards.
payload.longDescription: Wiley Scholar Gateway 让 ChatGPT 能够根据经过同行评审的来源生成回答，并提供可验证的引文和 DOI 链接。Wiley Scholar Gateway Connector 会搜索 Wiley 期刊文献，提供有证据支持的答案和完整来源元数据。借此，你可以核实各项说法是否有来源研究支持，确保研究符合专业标准。

payload.name: Academic Writing Toolkit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Academic Writing Toolkit helps users review pasted academic writing materials in ChatGPT. It can audit citation consistency between draft prose and reading-note source lines, check conservative British English spelling, flag paragraph-level logic issues, validate BibTeX records offline, and create a standard reading-notes Markdown template.
payload.longDescription: Academic Writing Toolkit 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中审阅粘贴的学术写作材料。它可以核查草稿正文与阅读笔记来源条目之间的引用一致性、检查传统英式英语拼写、标记段落层面的逻辑问题、离线验证 BibTeX 记录，并创建标准阅读笔记 Markdown 模板。

payload.name: Sider Scholar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your AI Research Assistant lets you search 350M+ research papers, chat with large volumes of research PDFs, and save findings to your Wisebase (knowledge base).

1. Global Academic Search (Search & Read)
- Major Sources: Search 350M+ papers from Google Scholar, PubMed, arXiv, and more.
- Read Instantly: Access full papers instantly to verify findings.

2. Build Your Knowledge Base (Save & Collect)
- Save for Continuous Research: Save searched papers to Wisebase for continuous questioning and deep analysis of your findings.
- Save Chat History: Save key research discussions as editable documents to capture and refine insights.

3. Unified Knowledge Analysis (Agentic RAG)
- Chat with Your Collection: Analyze your entire collection simultaneously.
- Traceable Sources: Get grounded answers with precise Reference Indices to verify every claim.

4. Visual Knowledge Organization (Visualize & Explore)
- Knowledge Graphing: Instantly generate interactive graphs from any paper to explore definitions, cause-and-effect links, and concept hierarchies.

Ideal Use Cases: For researchers, PhD students, and academics who need to access massive academic sources and synthesize grounded arguments with precise citations.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect Sider Scholar to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@Sider Scholar".

Sample Prompts
- Search Paper: “@Sider Scholar Search recent papers on 'LLM alignment' published in the last two years.”
- Chat with Knowledge Base: “@Sider Scholar Answer questions about 'CRISPR gene editing' using my Knowledge Base.”
- Visual Research: “@Sider Scholar Build a Knowledge Graph explaining key concepts in 'Reinforcement Learning'.”
payload.longDescription:
您的AI研究助手可搜索3.5亿+篇学术论文，与大量研究PDF进行对话，并将发现保存至您的Wisebase（知识库）中。

1.
全球学术搜索（搜索与阅读）
- 主要来源：从Google Scholar、PubMed、arXiv等平台搜索3.5亿+篇论文。
- 即时阅读：可立即访问完整论文以验证研究结果。

2.
构建知识库（保存与收集）
- 保存用于持续研究：将搜索到的论文保存至Wisebase，实现对研究发现的持续提问与深度分析。
- 保存对话记录：将关键研究讨论保存为可编辑文档，捕捉并提炼洞察结论。

3.
统一知识分析（智能体RAG）
- 与您的资料库对话：可同时分析整个资料库内容。
- 可追溯来源：通过精准的参考文献索引获取有依据的答案，验证每个主张的出处。

4.
可视化知识组织（可视化与探索）
- 知识图谱：可从任意论文即时生成交互式图表，探索定义、因果关系及概念层级。

理想应用场景：适用于需要访问海量学术资源并基于精确引用合成实证论点的研究人员、博士生及学术工作者。

在ChatGPT中使用方法
1.
连接应用：将Sider Scholar与ChatGPT连接。
2.
触发指令：输入“@Sider Scholar”。

示例提示
- 搜索论文："@Sider Scholar 搜索过去两年内发表的关于'LLM对齐'的最新论文。"
- 与知识库聊天："@Sider Scholar 使用我的知识库回答有关'CRISPR基因编辑'的问题。"
- 视觉研究："@Sider Scholar 构建一个知识图谱，解释'强化学习'中的关键概念。"

payload.name: quran.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ChatGPT into your AI-powered Quran study companion — trace themes across all 114 surahs, compare how classical and modern scholars interpret the same verse, unpack the depth and precision behind the Quran's eloquence, and contextualize difficult passages with real, authentic tafsir commentary. All data sourced from quran.com, so every verse, scholarly opinion, interpretation, and linguistic detail the AI cites is verified — not guessed from training data.
payload.longDescription: 将ChatGPT转化为你的AI驱动《古兰经》学习伙伴——追踪全部114章的主旨脉络，对比古典与现代学者对同一经文的解读，解析《古兰经》修辞背后的深度与精准性，并通过真实可靠的经注阐释理解疑难章节。所有数据均源自quran.com，因此AI引用的每句经文、学术观点、解释内容及语言细节均经过验证——而非基于训练数据的推测。

payload.name: Udemy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Learn skills that move you forward with the Udemy app in ChatGPT. With Udemy, you can turn your curiosity, questions, and “I need to figure this out” moments into real progress.

Just tell ChatGPT what you want to learn, and the Udemy app helps you discover courses and video previews from real-world experts. Explore what skills you can learn, how the course is structured, and if it fits your goals — before diving in.

payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 中的 Udemy 应用，学习能助你不断进步的技能。使用 Udemy，你可以把好奇心、问题以及“我得弄明白这件事”的时刻转化为切实进步。

只需告诉 ChatGPT 你想学什么，Udemy 应用就会帮你发现课程和真实领域专家的视频预览。了解可以学习哪些技能、课程结构如何，以及课程是否符合你的目标，然后再开始学习。

全球数百万学习者通过 Udemy 培养工作和生活所需的实用技能。现在，你可以在学习开始的地方找到合适课程，继续向前迈进。

payload.name: Music Block
payload.description: 创作乐谱与吉他谱 TAB
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Music Block turns music ideas in ChatGPT into playable sheet music and TAB.

Ask for guitar licks, piano voicings, bass lines, drum grooves, melodies, chord progressions, exercises, arrangements, or music theory examples, and Music Block renders them as engraved notation directly in the conversation.

Try prompts like “give me 5 melodic minor licks over B7alt,” “write a walking bass line over a ii–V–I,” “show me jazz piano voicings with smooth voice leading,” or “arrange this melody for string quartet.”

Music Block supports guitar, bass, ukulele, piano and keyboards, drums, strings, brass, woodwinds, saxophones, and voices. Guitar, bass, and ukulele examples include TAB; keyboards use a grand staff; ensembles can contain up to eight parts.

Every example includes playback, so you can hear what you are learning, change the tempo, and mute or solo individual parts. You can also work with alternate tunings, extended-range guitars and basses, swing and shuffle rhythms, tuplets, chord symbols, and common guitar techniques such as bends, slides, hammer-ons, and pull-offs.

Use Music Block for practice, teaching, songwriting, arranging, and exploring music theory with short, original examples created for your conversation.
payload.longDescription:
Music Block 可将你在 ChatGPT 中的音乐灵感转换为可播放的乐谱和吉他谱 TAB。

payload.longDescription: Amass 将你的助手连接到 6 个精选生物医学语料库：BioMedCore（43M+ 条记录：来自 PubMed/PMC 的同行评审出版物，以及学术协会会议摘要）、TrialCore（来自 ClinicalTrials.gov 和 WHO ICTRP 的 1.2M+ 项临床试验）、DrugCore（22K+ 种经过统一整理的药物/分子，涵盖药物类型、临床阶段、结构、同义名称及每种药物作用的基因靶点；与 ChEMBL 关联）、RegulatoryCore（7K+ 条统一整理的 FDA + EMA 上市许可，包含药品标签、审评文件、SmPC 和 EPAR 等源文件）、GeneCore（43K+ 个人类基因，经过统一整理，并提供靶点情报层，涵盖成药性、DepMap 必需性、ChEMBL 靶点类别、临床先例所体现的可开发性、经整理的安全风险和 gnomAD 约束），以及 PatentCore（预览版，生命科学专利，支持全文搜索、CPC/IPC 分类、受让人/发明人和专利族）。用户可以使用优于开放网络检索的筛选条件搜索和获取完整记录，并沿着语料库之间的交叉链接追溯到各自的底层来源。

payload.name: SkinKnowledgeBase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SkinKnowledgeBase is a public skincare knowledge website and AI-accessible reference layer for answering skincare and skincare-product questions with source-backed context.

payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Precise Special Functions
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Precise Special Functions computes high-precision values of specialized mathematical functions: Bessel (J, Y, I, K), Riemann zeta, Gauss hypergeometric ₂F₁, complete elliptic integrals (K and E), and the Gamma function. Suited for physics simulations, number theory, engineering calculations, and any context where a standard float or an inline code approximation is not precise enough. Every result is deterministic and cross-checkable against reference implementations. Ask naturally: "what is J₀(7.2) to 30 digits" and you get an exact value.
payload.longDescription: Precise Special Functions 可高精度计算专用数学函数：贝塞尔函数（J、Y、I、K）、黎曼 ζ 函数、高斯超几何函数 ₂F₁、完全椭圆积分（K 和 E）以及伽马函数。它基于 mpmath 实现任意精度运算，最高可达 1000 位小数。适用于物理模拟、数论、工程计算，以及标准浮点数或代码中的近似值精度不足的场景。每个结果都是确定性的，并可与参考实现交叉核验。自然地提问：“J₀(7.2) 精确到 30 位是多少？”即可得到精确值。

payload.name: Metronome: Music tempo+beat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.
payload.longDescription:
节拍器

需要稳定的节拍吗？这款节拍器随时可以帮忙。选择速度，按下开始，然后跟随节拍声练习。它让音乐练习变得轻松、清晰又有趣。

几乎任何乐器都可以使用。你可以练习钢琴、吉他、鼓、小提琴、贝斯、尤克里里、长笛、小号、萨克斯风、大提琴或其他乐器。也可以用于唱歌、跳舞、拍手、行进或学习节奏。如果你想保持稳定节拍，这款节拍器可以帮到你。

以 BPM 选择速度，BPM 即每分钟节拍数。想慢慢演奏？选较低的数值。想演奏得快些？选较高的数值。速度由你掌控，可以随时调整，直到感觉恰到好处。

如果不知道需要多少 BPM，可以使用点按测速。跟着脑海中听到的节拍轻点，节拍器会帮你找到速度。快速、简单又实用。

循序渐进地练习。先放慢速度，让双手记住音符。能够无误演奏后，再稍微加快节拍。不断重复，直到达到目标。小步前进能帮助你进步。

稳定的节拍是提升水平的最佳方法之一。它能改善你的节奏感、韵律感和信心。由于大家都跟随同一个节拍，它也能帮助你与他人合奏。

这款节拍器适合初学者、学生、教师、业余演奏者和专业音乐家。可用于课程、排练、热身、音乐会和日常练习。无论练习五分钟还是五小时，稳定的节拍都会让练习更有效。

用它来学习新歌、攻克难段、稳步提速，或更轻松地理解复杂节奏。阅读乐谱或练习音阶、和弦、琶音及其他练习时，也可以用它保持稳定节拍。

不同歌曲需要不同速度。慢板抒情曲与快速摇滚的感觉截然不同。古典、爵士、流行、民谣、布鲁斯、乡村、嘻哈等多种风格都讲究速度。找到合适的 BPM，音乐才能呈现应有的感觉。

教师可以在课堂上使用这款节拍器，学生可以在家练习，乐队可以在排练时使用，合唱团可以一起练习，鼓乐队可以保持整齐，独奏音乐家可以改善节奏感。任何想要稳定节拍的人都能使用它。

如果你正在学习节奏，可以提问。如果不确定该用什么 BPM，可以寻求帮助。如果想获得练习建议，也可以询问。你还可以了解音符时值、休止符、数拍、拍号、细分节拍、摇摆律动、重音，或练习困难节奏的方法。简单的解答能让学习更轻松。

试着设定小目标。正确演奏一行三次，把 BPM 提高几个节拍，然后重复练习，直到达到目标速度。慢练并不代表练得差，而是更聪明的练习方式。

演奏时记得放松。正常呼吸，保持良好姿势，仔细聆听每一下节拍声。试着让每个音符跟上节拍，而不是追赶节拍。良好的节奏感来自专注聆听和稳定练习。

这款节拍器设计得简单易用。开始时不需要特殊的音乐知识，只要选择速度、启动节拍并开始演奏即可。你可以随时调整速度。它的目标是让练习更轻松、更清晰、更愉快。

无论你是在学第一首歌、准备试演、与乐队排练、为音乐会做准备，还是单纯想改善节奏，这款节拍器都能助你一臂之力。保持节拍，稳住节奏，每天练习一点点。小进步会积累成大成果，每一拍都让你离成为更出色、更自信的音乐家更近一步。
